# ChartCard

## Summary

A chart as a first-class card: the AI (or a person) fills in a handful of flat, LLM-friendly fields and the card renders itself as an ECharts visualization — bar, line, stacked, donut, or a big-number KPI. Every chart reads one linked `Dataset` card (`dataset` is `linksTo(Dataset)`); the spec is validated by `validateChartSpec` before render, and problems show as a readable fix-list instead of a broken canvas. The chart type is an enum-style field surfaced as a row of BoxelUI pills in edit mode. The x axis is the compound `DimensionField` (`path` + time `bucket`) and the y axis the compound `MeasureField` (`path` + `aggregate`), both from `../fields` with their own Specs, and an optional `seriesBy` column splits the measure into series. `span` / `rowSpan` are layout hints a dashboard may read. The same card stands alone (isolated, tall), embeds in any dashboard tile, and can sit on several dashboards at once since position lives on each dashboard, not on the chart.

The module also exports `ChartView`, the shared Glimmer component both formats use — it builds the spec from the model, aggregates the linked Dataset's rows, and renders either the ECharts chart (painted with the theme's `--chart-1…7`, `--foreground` and `--muted-foreground`, so it follows the linked theme in light and dark), the formatted KPI value, a spec-error list, or the designed empty state.

## Import

```js
import { ChartCard, ChartView } from '../chart-card';
import { DimensionField, MeasureField } from '../fields';
```

## Usage

```js
new ChartCard({
  title: 'Deliveries by quarter',
  chartKind: 'bar',
  dataset: someDataset, // a linked Dataset card
  dimension: new DimensionField({ path: 'quarter', bucket: 'none' }),
  measure: new MeasureField({ path: 'deliveries', aggregate: 'sum' }),
});
```

Valid `chartKind`, `bucket`, and `aggregate` values come from `CHART_KINDS`, `BUCKETS`, and `AGGREGATES` in `../utils/chart-spec` — the edit-mode pickers offer exactly those options, so hand-typed invalid values can't happen through the UI.
